title: Frameworks, SSR, Worker, offline
note: Written before the Stage 5 sandbox run. Expected status is PASS for every assigned scenario. Any observed FAIL, BLOCKED or NOT RUN is a provisional agent result requiring parent review; this file is not self-approval and makes no release claim. Expected SVG hashes are fixed before execution; no expected value is updated from a Stage 5 observation.

golden.note: base is the parent-accepted S2-08/S3 fixture set; seed and name sets were derived from the frozen approved tarball before execution.

browsers.alternativeLimit: Firefox is used for Vue production initial/update parity and plain-HTML offline; Chromium covers every scenario and every framework host. Native Safari remains BLOCKED in the matrix and is not claimed.

negativeControls: S5-NC1 bad installed-package import is rejected
S5-NC2 one-character wrong SVG hash is rejected with diff
S5-NC3 hydration SSR/client mismatch is rejected using the same checker

S5-01.title: Next.js SSR
S5-01.expected: An actual HTTP response from a Next production server started from an app that installed the approved tarball contains HTML with all eight server-rendered avatars as data:image/svg+xml URLs (or inline SVG). Decoding each URL yields raw SVG byte-identical to the fixed base golden hash for that style. The response is a real page, not a build-success claim or an error page.
cases: SSR response is HTML containing data URLs from the installed package
all eight server styles match frozen raw SVG hashes

S5-02.title: Next production and hydration
S5-02.expected: With JavaScript disabled, the production page contains the same eight raw SVG data URLs. With JavaScript enabled, hydration completes without console errors or page errors, the hydrated initial avatars are byte-identical to the no-JS SSR bytes, and real controls update seed, name and every style to the frozen expected raw hashes. Changing name leaves the five non-letter backgrounds unchanged and changes only the three letter styles (Q-001 background invariance).
cases: hydrated initial bytes equal no-JS SSR bytes
name control updates all eight with five backgrounds invariant
style control selects all eight expected hash values
no console errors or page errors

S5-03.title: Vue 3 dev and production
S5-03.expected: Vue 3 dev and production servers render all eight avatars from the installed tarball; each decoded image data URL matches the frozen base hashes. Reactive seed, name and style controls update the live grid/current avatar to the frozen expected hashes. No console errors or page errors. The production build is served by the framework preview server; Firefox repeats initial and update checks on production within the documented alternative-browser limit.
cases: dev no console or page errors
production no console or page errors

S5-04.title: Svelte dev and production
S5-04.expected: Svelte (runes) dev and production servers render all eight avatars from the installed tarball with frozen raw hashes, and reactive controls update seed/name/style to the frozen expected values. No console errors or page errors. Chromium screenshots are captured for both modes.
cases: dev no console or page errors
production no console or page errors

S5-05.title: Cloudflare workerd Worker and browser Worker
S5-05.expected: TWO runtimes are exercised without deployment. A local wrangler/workerd dev server built from the installed tarball returns all eight SVG bodies with Content-Type image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8; the workerd response headers show no Node process version and no DOM document global; the workerd bundle has no node: imports. Separately, a real Chromium page starts a classic browser Web Worker that loads the installed package IIFE, generates all eight avatars, and posts them back; all eight raw SVGs match frozen hashes and there are no worker errors or external requests. No worker is deployed or published.
cases: workerd /health shows no Node process version or DOM globals
workerd all eight SVG bodies and content type
browser Web Worker postMessage all eight

S5-06.title: Plain HTML offline
S5-06.expected: A plain HTML page loads the classic IIFE copied from the installed tarball over file:// with the browser context offline. All eight avatars render from data URLs and match the frozen base hashes. Every observed request is file://; no http(s), remote-font or other network request occurs. The IIFE asset hash matches the tarball entry. Chromium and Firefox both render all eight within the documented alternative-browser limit.
cases: IIFE asset comes from installed package and hash matches tarball
all eight raw hashes match frozen base

S5-07.title: Framework parity
S5-07.expected: Decoded raw SVG bytes from every framework host are compared byte-for-byte against the Node-frozen hashes, with no normalization step. Hosts: Next SSR, Next hydrated, Vue dev, Vue production, Svelte dev, Svelte production, workerd HTTP, browser Web Worker, and plain file://. All 72 style-host comparisons match the base golden. The Q-001 ascii-letter fixture is asserted explicitly in every host. Any JSX/HTML serialization difference is reported with first-difference context, never hidden by normalization or canonicalization.
cases: Q-001 ascii-letter in every framework host
browser bundle provenance from installed package only
